meta.anchorTruth: After becoming convinced that her husband had set up a secret second household, Park Ji-yeon manipulated a power of attorney, cancelled the ₩20M joint savings account, and lost the full amount to an investment chat scam. Lee Jun-ho was not having an affair; he was caring for the middle-school-aged child of his older brother, who was in personal rehabilitation, and he handed ₩30M in cash from his personal hidden fund to that brother.
meta.emotionalBait: A husband who stops by the same Officetel every day after work. Receipts for women’s items found in his car. Calls before dawn. His wife becomes convinced he has a secret second household.
meta.resolutionDilemma: Who should bear the heavier responsibility: the husband who, while trying to protect his older brother in personal rehabilitation and that brother’s child, handed over ₩30M in cash from his personal hidden fund; or the wife who, convinced she had been betrayed, manipulated a power of attorney, cancelled the ₩20M joint savings account, and lost the full amount to an investment chat scam? The husband hid things first, the wife began monitoring accounts first, and the wife committed the criminal act.

context.description: A husband who stops at the same Officetel every day after work. Receipts for women's items found in his car. Calls in the early morning. His wife becomes convinced he has a secret household.
context.triggerAmplifier: At first, the receipts (hair ties/lip tint), Officetel GPS, and early-morning calls all point in one direction: an affair. But as more clues surface, that picture falters. Unspoken circumstances on both sides and the movement of money come to light, shifting the case beyond suspicion of infidelity.

disputes.name: Officetel Visit and Early-Morning Call
disputes.truthDescription: The Officetel visits were to care for his niece, a second-year middle-school student, at his older brother's Officetel. The early-morning calls were urgent contact with his brother.
disputes.judgmentStatement: The Officetel visits were not an affair, but family care.

verdictOptions.wrong: Lee Jun-ho visited the Officetel because he had a secret household.
verdictOptions.partial: The Officetel visits do not prove a secret household, but they are likely an affair.
verdictOptions.truth: The Officetel visits were not an affair, but family care.
verdictOptions.defer: The substance is unclear for now. Judgment is deferred.

disputes.name: Large Withdrawal from the Husband's Account
disputes.truthDescription: Without his wife knowing, Lee Jun-ho withdrew ₩30M in hidden funds from a separate account in his own name, saved over nearly ten years, in cash over the last four months: ₩5M, ₩8M, ₩7M, then ₩10M. His explanation is that his older brother was in personal debt rehabilitation, making account deposits difficult, so he handed over cash. The money was personal funds unrelated to the joint savings account.
disputes.judgmentStatement: The husband bears greater responsibility for handing over ₩30M in personal hidden funds in cash.

verdictOptions.truth: The ₩30M in personal hidden funds was cash handed to his older brother during personal debt rehabilitation.
verdictOptions.defer: Where the money went cannot be determined. Judgment is deferred.

truthTable.fact: B’s Officetel visits were to his older brother and that brother’s child, not an affair partner.
B hid ₩30M in personal hidden funds from his spouse and handed it to his older brother in cash.
After becoming convinced her husband was having an affair, A manipulated a power of attorney, cancelled the ₩20M joint savings account, and transferred the full amount to an investment chat.
B began the concealment first, while A executed the actual secret transfer first.
Both had reasons they could not speak of, but both moved joint property on their own.

공동재산회복: Separate the flow of the ₩30M personal hidden-fund withdrawal, the ₩20M joint savings cancellation, and the ₩20M investment chat transfer, then reconcile recoverable amounts against losses.
Support for the brother’s family is allowed only through a separate agreement process, apart from marital joint property.
신뢰순서분리: Record the start of concealment separately from the actual execution of transfers, and judge emotional betrayal apart from execution responsibility.
Rebuild both the rules for discussing the in-laws and the rules for prior consent over joint property.
봉인정보경계: Release minor-related information and health-sensitive information only to the extent necessary.
Resolve the affair misunderstanding, but leave family care and overreach over joint property as separate responsibilities.

recipes.discoveryText: The receipt purchase locations match the dashcam stop coordinates. A pattern of buying only near the Officetel is confirmed.
The middle-school workbook in the receipt bundle and the school notice mixed into the texts align as Family Circumstances.
Lee Jun-ho's personal-account withdrawals and Park Ji-yeon's investment-chat transfer line up in time. Check whether the two money flows point to separate responsibilities.
The joint savings cancellation amount exactly matches the transfer to the investment chat. The destination of the withdrawn money is confirmed.
Ms. Park Ji-yeon's claim that she "tried to protect her share" and the power-of-attorney handling point in the same direction. The joint savings cancellation was not accidental, but a deliberate act.
The explanation that it was a family matter aligns with the text messages. Confirm directly who the other person was and what care was provided.
Placed side by side, "a family matter" and "I tried to protect my share" reveal overlapping reasons for not telling each other first.
